interface.shortDescription: v0.28.0 · Retired: codecollab is now becos. Install becos@becos instead.
interface.longDescription: codecollab is now becos. This retired plugin captures nothing, recalls nothing, starts no tool server and makes no network call; it only shows how to switch. Run `codex plugin remove codex-codecollab@becos` and `codex plugin add becos@becos`, then restart Codex, re-trust the hooks with /hooks and start a fresh task. Your sign-in and history carry over.
